name: Healthy standby does not hand off or poll Telegram
PING success does not override repeated write-canary quota failures
Network, 429 and 5xx failures activate only after threshold
401 and 403 authentication failures fail closed
Malformed or configuration 4xx failures fail closed
Missing, stale or profile-login-server mismatched EA evidence blocks activation
Startup reconciles crash after deleteWebhook before state save
getUpdates is forbidden while webhook ownership is not verified empty
Handoff preserves pending updates and verifies webhook empty
Second controller process is rejected by the single-instance lock
Unauthorized Telegram chat cannot create intent or broker mutation
More than ten non-empty lines is rejected atomically
Valid multiline commands are per-line idempotent across replay
Reply failure resends stored outcome without recreating command
Local intent IDs are namespaced and bare cloud numeric IDs are rejected
Immediate broker mutation requires approval and delete-cancel never executes
Entry protection uses snapshot defaults and rejects missing protection
Account identity, stale snapshot and cTrader target mismatches are rejected
Timed intent auto-arms, remains PC-owned across recovery and expires instead of executing too late
Canonical origin matches cloud-local and differs by line and account
Mutation origin is mandatory while positions remains read-only
Cloud-local race for one origin has one atomic claim winner and one execution
Existing final result reconciles without executing again
Existing claim without result becomes UNCERTAIN and is never replayed
Recovery fences before setWebhook, blocks on fence failure and verifies exact URL
Restart, v1 migration and corrupted evidence fail closed without blind replay
Local-primary takes Telegram ownership, verifies the empty webhook and polls updates
Local-primary without takeover consent stays blocked while a webhook is active
Local-primary mutations use runtime EA identity and the local-primary task source
Optional web H1 signal sync succeeds, defers on failure and drops cancelled intents
Local-primary heartbeats the cloud fence with throttling and tolerates missing Upstash
Overdue local-primary scheduled intents expire without broker execution
Scheduled dispatch is driven by the exact dueAt, not a minute scheduler, with timing evidence
Controller restart before dueAt reloads durable state and dispatches exactly once
Telegram outage does not block scheduled execution and reconnect resumes update processing
Web H1 sync outage never delays or blocks broker dispatch
Multiple MT5 accounts route deterministically via explicit @ACCOUNT targeting
Cloud fence heartbeat renews after its throttle window and expires server-side by TTL
